review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Swedish Group EG is Egypt’s hub for integrated architectural, interior, and high-performance building systems, operating through four specialized subsidiaries that work as one team under a unified project framework. The group manages global material sourcing and representation, project-based sales and turnkey commercial leadership, local manufacturing and custom fabrication, and complete on-site fit-out and installation. Swedish Group EG combines European-led technologies with local engineering, fabrication, and site execution to deliver precise, efficient solutions tailored to the Egyptian market. Its design-to-delivery workflow offers clients a single accountable partner across façade systems, interiors, smart technologies, acoustics, flooring, cladding, and more. The company is driven by core values of sustainability, innovation, and excellence, creating future-ready environments for commercial and architectural projects. Role Description The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across Swedish Group EG’s integrated architectural and building systems offerings. This role includes identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, developing and nurturing relationships with key decision-makers, and managing the sales pipeline from prospecting through negotiation to closure. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with trading, project sales, manufacturing, and fit-out teams to build comprehensive proposals, respond to RFPs, and align solutions with client specifications and project requirements. Day-to-day activities include conducting market and competitor analysis, preparing sales forecasts and reports, representing the company in client meetings and industry events, and ensuring that projects support the organization’s sustainability, innovation, and excellence standards. The role also involves working with internal stakeholders to refine go-to-market strategies and support long-term partnerships with global and local clients. Qualifications Business development and sales expertise, including experience in B2B selling, account management, and pipeline management within construction, architecture, building materials, or related industries. Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage architects, consultants, contractors, and end clients at multiple decision-making levels. Market research and strategic planning skills, including the ability to analyze trends, identify opportunities, and develop targeted business plans and go-to-market strategies. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; Arabic proficiency is highly beneficial, with the ability to prepare clear proposals, technical submissions (with support from internal teams), and commercial offers. Solid project coordination capabilities, collaborating with trading, manufacturing, fit-out, and engineering teams to ensure alignment between client requirements and delivered solutions. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Architecture, Marketing, or a related field; relevant experience in integrated building systems, interior fit-out, or façade solutions is a strong advantage.

This is a remote, freelance opportunity Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development, with experience building and deploying robust applications. Proficiency in Neural Networks and Pattern Recognition to design and optimize AI models for structured and unstructured data. Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), including text classification, information extraction, and conversational interfaces. Knowledge of modern AI/ML frameworks and tools (e.g., Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) and version control (e.g., Git). Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to translate business and user requirements into technical solutions, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience in consulting, education technology, or professional services platforms is beneficial.
